title: 1-Efficient Triangulations and the Index of a Cusped Hyperbolic 3-Manifold
note: arXiv:1303.5278, Geom. Topol. 19 (2015) 2619-2689. Added 2026-07-17 from library/arxiv-1303.5278v1/1303.5278v1.pdf. Promotes the 3d index of an ideal triangulation to a topological invariant of the cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold, with the explicit figure-eight m004 single-flux-sum — the concrete m004 gluing computation for the QOU G3 / $A_\omega$ Stokes-integer route (companion to dimofte-gaiotto-gukov2013).
